title: Bayesian optimization identifies enzyme nanohybrids with high activity recovery
summary: Parallelized hybrid-space Bayesian optimization prioritized metal/ligand carriers and conditions for enzyme immobilization. The primary abstract reports activity recovery of 100% for glucose oxidase, 90% for catalase and 79% for Candida antarctica lipase B across the demonstrated workflow. These are enzyme-specific assay outcomes, not discovery of new enzymes or proof of industrial stability.
organization: Tsinghua University; Synthera Biotechnology Co. Ltd.

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific measured result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and clinical or industrial efficacy are not established.
evidence.ai_role: The optimizer proposes carrier compositions and experimental conditions, then experimental activity feedback informs later proposals.

source_review.scope: Primary publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata
